chapter: Reel 2: Los Angeles musicians, the Apex and Cotton Club
title: Marvin Johnson, Marshall Royal and other players in Les Hite's sections
summary: Collette and Howard sort out Hite's alto players and the trumpets, including Lloyd Reese and George Orendorff.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Now, Marvin Johnson, I don't know who he was playing with, but he played a lot of --
-- a lot of bands, with a lot of bands.
Yeah, he was with Les Hite, wasn't he? Marvin was? And Marshall Royal?
So those were probably the two alto players, Marshall Royal and Marvin Johnson.
Yeah, they were the two altos. There was a third guy. He lived up in -- oh, he lived in hot dog! (inaudible). Okay, I'm trying to think --
What about Jones, does that sound like the guy's name? Charlie Jones.
Charlie Jones. He lived up in Oakland.
What about the trumpet section? Lloyd Reese.
Lloyd Reese was one of them.
I can't think who the other one was.
It could have been George, but George came here from Chicago.
He might have been playing with them at one time, George Orendorff.
